cards.title: Best-ranked model selection
items: Each free group is scored by weighted LMArena percentiles: agent 0.35, webdev 0.35, text 0.15.
Both agent and webdev matches are required. Highest quality score is probed first; exhausted routes move to the next ranked model.
Unranked models are listed but skipped. Stale or missing benchmark data preserves the current OpenCode default.

cards.title: Extending provider order
items: Add or reorder a provider group in selection.json; Zen and Go groups receive their daily model lists automatically.
A new provider can use a fixed group with explicit model IDs; confirm its billing behavior before placing it in the order.
The daily runner remains in automation/model-control; this tool owns ranking, model-list.json, and OpenCode configuration.

cards.title: Quality evidence limit
items: Arena is a public human-preference leaderboard proxy, not a direct measurement of this user's coding tasks.
Only the chosen model receives a live synthetic OK route check; remaining candidates are not marked healthy.
The free-name suffix is a provider convention, not an independent billing audit.
